# Announcing LASEC: LLM Application Security Executive Certification


### Including a never before seen exploit from PromptArmor's cutting edge threat intelligence team.


[PromptArmor](https://substack.com/@promptarmor)


Mar 20, 2024


[Register here](https://tqtllr1lcql.typeform.com/to/MSGeJNaL)


Over the past year, the PromptArmor threat intelligence team has conducted 50+ LLM application pentests. Our conversations with CISOs and security leadership have centered around the latest threats and how their internal and external LLM use cases are affected.


As future-forward CISOs continue to come to us for LLM Application security advice, we realize the need to distribute this knowledge to a broader audience.


LASEC is the LLM application security certification that combines what Fortune 100 CISOs are prioritizing with the latest threat intelligence in the field: creating the comprehensive guide to LLM application security.


In LASEC you will learn about:


-


A never before seen exploit (uncovered by PromptArmor’s threat intelligence team)


-


LLM AppSec fundamentals


-


Top 10 threat examples in the wild


-


Best practices on implementing an LLM Security Program


-


The best LLM AppSec compliance standards for your organization (LSOC Type I, NIST, OWASP, etc)


-


How to enable your product team to build powerful LLM Applications, while still preserving your security posture.


-


…and much more!


[Register Here](https://tqtllr1lcql.typeform.com/to/MSGeJNaL?typeform-source=promptarmor.substack.com)
